camel_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl DeepfakeDetectIntlStream --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode FACE_DEEPFAKE --MerchantBizId e0c34a000353888 --version 2022-08-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Provides face deepfake detection capabilities for ID Verification, which can be independently integrated through API operations
description_zh: ID Verification 提供了人脸Deepfake检测能力，可以通过接口的形式单独接入
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl deepfake-detect-intl-stream --product-code FACE_DEEPFAKE --merchant-biz-id e0c34a000353888 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeepfakeDetectIntlStream

parameters.help_en: The product solution to be integrated. Valid values: FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案。
取值：FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom authentication scenario ID, which is used to query related records in the console. The value must be 10 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。

支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value must be a 32-character alphanumeric string. The prefix consists of a custom merchant abbreviation, the middle part can contain a time period, and the suffix can be a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh:
商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。

其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The input type of the face material. Valid values:

IMAGE: face image. This is the default value.
VIDEO: face video.

Note: Video processing takes a long time. We recommend that you set the timeout period to a value greater than 3 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
人脸素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：人脸图片
VIDEO：人脸视频

说明
视频处理时间较久，建议超时时间设置>3S
parameters.name: face_input_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the face image. For videos, we recommend that you pass the data as a stream
parameters.help_zh: 传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码，视频格式建议通过流方式传入
parameters.name: face_base64

parameters.help_en: The input stream of the image
parameters.name: face_file

Result.description_en:
The risk result. Valid values:

0: low risk.
1: high risk.
2: suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险
1：高风险
2：可疑

additionalProperties.description_en: The score of the corresponding tag returned when a risk is detected
additionalProperties.description_zh: 命中风险时返回对应标签分数

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk tags. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

SuspectDeepForgery: suspected deepfake.
SuspectPSFace: suspected synthetic attack.
SuspectTemple: suspected template attack.
SuspectRemake: suspected presentation attack
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签。多个标签使用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

SuspectDeepForgery：疑似深度伪造
SuspectPSFace：疑似合成攻击
SuspectTemple：疑似模板攻击
SuspectRemake：疑似呈现攻击

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
